text_en: According to Shenzhen Economic Daily, in the first three quarters of this year, the A-share IPO market continued to recover, with fundraising scale rising sharply. According to Wind data, in the first three quarters of this year, A-share equity financing reached 750.861 billion yuan, of which 123 companies raised 216.315 billion yuan through IPOs, up 180% year on year; 175 companies raised 465.489 billion yuan through additional issuance, down 40% year on year; 60 companies raised 68.572 billion yuan through convertible bonds, up 56% year on year; 1 company raised 484 million yuan through rights issue. According to Wind data, in the first three quarters of this year, there were 123 A-share IPO companies, with total IPO fundraising of 216.315 billion yuan. Among them, 12 were on the Shanghai Main Board, 10 on the Shenzhen Main Board, 19 on the STAR Market, 20 on the ChiNext, and 62 on the Beijing Stock Exchange.
